Both call rank_matches('cat', ['hat','bat','cut','cat'], limit=3) but expect different tie-break orderings: test_ties_and_duplicates wants [('cat',1.0),('hat',0.67),('bat',0.67)] while test_regression_issue_519 wants [('cat',1.0),('bat',0.67),('cut',0.67)]. No implementation can satisfy both. The docstring only specifies 'best score first' and does not define tie-breaking. Implementation follows the docstring (stable first-seen tie-break). Please reconcile in the post-release QA pass.
